title: Give each price-feed subscription its own off switch

cases.says: an open subscription hears every price of its symbol and none of other symbols
after its subscription is closed a widget hears no more prices and the feed no longer holds it
closing one subscription of a listener subscribed to two symbols leaves the other subscription working
closing one widget's subscription leaves other widgets on the same symbol subscribed
when the same listener is subscribed twice to one symbol, closing one subscription, even twice, leaves the other working

origin.section: A Listener Is Removed by the Reference It Was Added With, and a Second Lambda Is Another Object
